plan.title: The Design Critique Kit for Non-Native Designers
plan.problem: A non-native English-speaking designer struggles to confidently participate in and lead design critiques due to anxiety about language and communication.

plan.whyPayerPays: They pay to overcome anxiety, improve communication skills, avoid career stagnation, and prevent costly design revisions caused by miscommunication.
